title: The Best Camp, Boat & Deer Stand Coffee Makers
dek: Real coffee where there's no outlet: hunting camp, the boat landing, the tailgate.
intro: Lowcountry mornings start early: sunrise on the river, a cold deer stand in November, a tailgate before kickoff. Gas-station coffee is fine, but you can do a lot better with gear that packs small and doesn't need power.
These are the picks that hold up to being thrown in a truck bed.
how_we_picked: We favored rugged, no-power gear that survives truck beds and boat decks. Specs are from the Amazon listings.

picks.award: Best for one person on the go
picks.verdict: The whole kit packs inside its own mug. Truck, boat, deer stand, hotel.
Nearly unbreakable and very forgiving. Two minutes, great cup.
Stainless, campfire-proof, six cups. Classic hunting camp coffee.

picks.award: Best strong coffee on a camp stove
picks.verdict: Moka pot coffee is rich and bold, and the pot weighs next to nothing.
A hand grinder means fresh coffee with no outlet. Quiet enough for a dark campsite.

bar_tip: Pre-weigh your coffee at home into small zip bags, one per brew. In the dark at 5 a.m. you'll be glad you did.

faq.a: Percolator for a crowd around a fire; AeroPress for one or two great cups with minimal weight.
